column1: # TVI-WO-1202a: each case's and mutant's wall time in seconds, the weight tools/tviburi-route plan packs shards by.
# Re-weighed by TVI-WO-1204 (6) from two CI runs, main's 45804127687 (the push of d6e88c9, #61's merge) and #63's own
# 45846324975, with 1202a's method: an item's time is the gap from the previous item's last line to its own. Each shard's
# speed is its median item against the previous weights, over each run's Intel Xeon 6975P-C shards (seven, 0.97-1.01; four,
# 0.97-1.02); an item weighs the mean of its times divided by its shard's speed. So every weight is at the 6975P-C's speed
# (1.00). #63's first run read its four 6975P-C shards at 0.967-1.018 of the plan these weights replace (TVI-WO-1204 FEEDBACK).
# teardown and TD01-endFlush, held since 15:48Z (about 20 s on Furnace, scaled by its measured 1.18), are estimates.
# TVI-WO-1205's clause-6 mutants (TM34, FL42, US63, I265, AD48, DX34, PW39, C36, G25, DM72, I266, AD49) and its per-cell check-tool
# copies (R20-R33) are estimates: each named case's weight plus 4 s, as the sweeps' other mutants.
# The previous weights are in this file's git history.
# Never the list of what runs: that is the tree's own (tests/spike.sh, tests/mutants.tsv); an item missing here
# weighs its kind's median and still runs. KIND<tab>ID<tab>SECONDS.
